l-e-m1-b05-12.material: teach → teacher (mtu anayefundisha), sing → singer (mtu anayeimba), farm → farmer (mtu anayelima), bake → baker (mtu anayeoka mkate).
l-e-m1-b05-12.s.s1.prompt: -er inatoa maana gani inapoongezwa kwenye kitenzi?

l-e-m1-b05-12.s.s1.r.b: Farmer si mahali; ni mtu anayelima.
l-e-m1-b05-12.s.s1.r.c: Singer si wakati; ni mtu anayeimba.
l-e-m1-b05-12.s.s1.explain: Maneno yote manne ni watu wanaofanya kitendo hicho. Neno linapoishia na e, kama bake, ongeza r tu.
l-e-m1-b05-12.s.s2.model.0: Teacher, singer, farmer na baker zote ni watu wanaofanya kitendo hicho, kwa hiyo -er inamaanisha mtu anayekifanya.
l-e-m1-b05-12.s.s2.model.1: Mifano yote minne inamaanisha watu, kwa hiyo kanuni ni kwamba kitenzi + er humaanisha mtu anayefanya kitendo hicho.

l-e-m1-b05-13.title: Wingi wa nomino inayoishia na f ni upi?
l-e-m1-b05-13.topic: Wingi wa maneno yanayoishia na f
l-e-m1-b05-13.goal: Tafuta na eleza kanuni kutoka kwa mifano kadhaa ya wingi wa nomino zinazoishia na f au fe, kisha kagua kanuni hiyo kwa kisa kipya.
l-e-m1-b05-13.s.s1.prompt: Wingi wa shelf kwa kanuni hiyohiyo ni upi?
l-e-m1-b05-13.s.s1.r.a: Katika mifano, f ilibadilishwa kuwa v na -es ikaongezwa.
l-e-m1-b05-13.s.s1.r.d: Unahitaji kuongeza -es baada ya v (leaf → leaves).
l-e-m1-b05-13.s.s1.explain: Baadhi ya nomino zinazoishia na f au fe hubadilisha f(e) kuwa v na kuongeza -es. Wingi wa shelf ni shelves.
l-e-m1-b05-13.s.s2.model.0: Leaf, wolf na half zote hubadilisha f kuwa v na kuongeza -es, kwa hiyo shelf pia huwa shelves.
l-e-m1-b05-13.s.s2.model.1: Knife hubadilisha fe kuwa ves na nyingine hubadilisha f kuwa ves, kwa hiyo kanuni ni kwamba shelf pia huwa shelves.

l-e-m1-b05-14.title: Kutengeneza nomino kwa -ness
l-e-m1-b05-14.goal: Tafuta na eleza kanuni kutoka kwa mifano kadhaa ya nomino zenye -ness, kisha kagua kanuni hiyo kwa kisa kipya.
l-e-m1-b05-14.material: happy → happiness, kind → kindness, dark → darkness, sad → sadness. Zote ni nomino zilizotengenezwa kutoka kwa vivumishi.
l-e-m1-b05-14.s.s1.prompt: Kwa kanuni hiyohiyo, nomino iliyotengenezwa kutoka ill (mgonjwa) ni ipi?
l-e-m1-b05-14.s.s1.r.a: -ly ni mwisho unaotengeneza vielezi. Kanuni ni -ness.
l-e-m1-b05-14.s.s1.r.c: -ment ni kanuni tofauti. Mifano yote inatumia -ness.
l-e-m1-b05-14.s.s1.r.d: -ful ni kanuni tofauti. Mifano yote inatumia -ness.
l-e-m1-b05-14.s.s1.explain: Ongeza -ness baada ya kivumishi ili kutengeneza nomino. ill + ness = illness (ugonjwa).
l-e-m1-b05-14.s.s2.model.0: Maneno yote manne huongeza -ness baada ya kivumishi, kwa hiyo ill pia huwa illness.
l-e-m1-b05-14.s.s2.model.1: Kind huwa kindness na sad huwa sadness, kwa hiyo kutumia kanuni hiyohiyo kwa ill kunatoa illness.

l-e-m1-b05-15.goal: Tafuta na eleza kanuni kutoka kwa mifano kadhaa ya viambishi awali vinavyotengeneza maneno kinyume, kisha kagua kanuni hiyo kwa kisa kipya.
